name: Mercure Kuala Lumpur Shaw Parade
short_description: A 213-room hotel between Bukit Bintang and Pudu, with a rooftop pool, KL skyline views, and complimentary in-suite minibars restocked daily.
ai_summary: Mercure Kuala Lumpur Shaw Parade sits between the Bukit Bintang and Pudu neighbourhoods, both full of shops, restaurants, and street life, on Jalan Changkat Thambi Dollah. The 213-room hotel offers stunning KL skyline views from higher floors, a rooftop pool and bar, and eco-conscious in-room water filters, with suite guests enjoying a complimentary minibar restocked daily and artisanal welcome snacks. Guests consistently praise the attentive, proactive service and the local Malaysian breakfast options, with the main watchouts being dated bathroom fittings in some rooms and occasional breakfast items running low during peak periods.

faqs.question: Does Mercure Kuala Lumpur Shaw Parade have a rooftop pool?
faqs.answer: Yes -- the rooftop pool and bar offer stunning KL skyline views, particularly striking from the hotel's higher floors, and is one of the property's most frequently praised features.

faqs.question: What's included with suites at Mercure Kuala Lumpur Shaw Parade?
faqs.answer: Suite guests get a complimentary minibar restocked daily along with artisanal welcome snacks and seasonal fruits -- an unusually generous inclusion for the hotel's midscale-to-upscale price point.

reviews.title: Hotel Review: Mercure Kuala Lumpur Shaw Parade - A Hidden Gem in the Heart of the City
reviews.summary: Calls it a hidden gem, praising the complimentary stocked minibar, welcome amenities, KL skyline views, rooftop pool, in-room water filters, and attentive service, in a convenient spot between Bukit Bintang and KLCC.
